summary: A Danforth practice with over 25 years of experience is a strength, but leftover test text in the booking form and no hours appear to cost you new patients.

findings.problem: The booking form appears to include the dropdown text 'Test Optio' and repeats it in the Request Appointment modal.
findings.cost: Patients see unfinished test text exactly where they try to book, which looks careless.
findings.fix: A clean labeled booking form with real options.

findings.problem: The Book an Appointment button appears to link to a contact form with no visible submit button, and no online booking appears.
findings.cost: Patients who are ready to book may give up before the request is sent.
findings.fix: A working booking form with a visible submit button and confirmation.

findings.problem: No office hours or emergency hours appear, and the page appears to say both 25 years and more than 30 years of service.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell when you are open, and mixed claims weaken trust.
findings.fix: Visible hours and one verified experience claim.

findings.problem: Only three testimonials appear with no star ratings or platform, one reviewer name reads like a gaming handle, and the stray word Image appears above photos.
findings.cost: Thin and odd proof gives a new patient little reason to choose you over another dentist.
findings.fix: Real Google reviews with ratings and a clean page.

redesign: A clean booking form with a visible button.
Visible hours and one verified claim.
Real reviews and a polished layout.
